roster.name: Neurodata Without Borders (NWB)
roster.description: A community-developed data standard and formal format specification for neurophysiology and behavioral data. NWB defines a schema of neurodata_types and type specifications to represent time series, imaging, extracellular and intracellular electrophysiology, optogenetics, behavior/tracking, devices, subjects, processing modules, and related metadata; it includes an extension mechanism (NDX) and an ecosystem of tools (e.g., PyNWB, MatNWB, NeuroConv, NWB GUIDE) for creating, validating, converting, and sharing NWB files.
